Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: 

1) Yes — for Dedicated pools we support region anchoring. Production data, KV caches, and automated snapshots are configured to remain in the pinned region by default. Cross-region replication is an opt-in configuration and is disabled unless you request it.

2) We have a two-stage deletion flow: a) tenant tombstone (logical delete + retention hold) then b) physical purge (irreversible wipe). Standard turnaround for the physical purge is 14 days after tombstone unless an expedited purge is requested and approved.

3) We can provide an export of the purge event log (signed by our KMS key) and a deletion certificate that includes snapshot IDs, storage object names, and timestamps. That evidence is what most auditors accept.

I'm looping in Karthik from infra for the artifacts and timeline details.

—Mina

Hi all — Q&A / artifact plan below (technical detail):

1) Region anchoring: 
- Data plane: All runtime payloads, model KV caches, and S3-backed snapshots are pinned to the customer-chosen AZ/region. No automatic cross-region replication for Dedicated by default.
- Control plane metadata: minimal routing metadata (tenant_id, region tag) is stored in our control plane (in our US-west control cluster). This metadata contains no full payloads and is replicated across control-plane replicas for availability.

2) Deletion flow (two-stage):
- Tombstone (logical delete): We mark the tenant as inactive in the control plane, disable routing keys, and apply a retention hold on snapshots/archives. This generates a tombstone event with UUID and timestamp.
- Quarantine window: Default 14-day quarantine during which we retain snapshots for rollback, unless an Expedited Purge is requested.
- Physical purge: After quarantine we run region-local irreversible wipes of object storage and KV caches and remove snapshot indices. Wipes are executed by the region ops plane; operators do not move data out of region to perform wipes.

3) Evidence we can provide: 
- Deletion certificate (PDF) signed with our KMS key that enumerates object IDs, snapshot SHAs, and purge timestamp.
- Signed audit log extract (append-only) showing the tombstone event and purge job completion. Timestamps are RFC3339 and include operator run IDs.
- Optional notarized statement (third-party) for customers with higher assurance needs (procured separately).

4) Expedited purge options: 
- Customer can request expedited purge; requires an ops ticket + approval and carries a one-time fee. Expedited purges target completion within 72 hours and include the same certificate artifacts.

I've attached a draft deletion certificate (tombstone-playbook.pdf) and a scrubbed erase log sample (erase-log-sample.csv). Ben: I left placeholders where you should insert a scrubbed example.

-Karthik
